title: Bug: useOptimistic fails to revert when independent async actions overlap due to global scope entanglement
author: acefolioDev
body_preview: There is a correctness bug in useOptimistic where the "revert" mechanism is gated by a global (per-root) async action reference count rather than being scoped to the specific action or transition that triggered it.
